newsitem.title: UK: Ofgas says Brit Gas not serious about talks.
newsitem.headline: Ofgas says Brit Gas not serious about talks.

text.p: Gas industry regulator Clare Spottiswoode said on Thursday that British Gas Plc had not been serious in its negotiations with Ofgas over price controls on its pipeline and storage arm, TransCo.
Earlier the company rejected the proposals, triggering a lengthy Monopolies and Mergers Commission inquiry, saying "all our efforts to achieve an acceptable resolution have failed."
But in an increasing war of words between the company and Ofgas, Spottiswoode told a news conference "this has not been a process where we felt they were seriously in discussion."
